profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Cisco Meraki | Full-Stack Developer (React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript) | Passionate About Building User-Centric Products & Scalable APIs
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hey! I'm a first-generation Computer Science grad from Brooklyn College 🎓.

I'm passionate about full-stack web development 💻, focusing on building interactive, user-centric web applications with modern technologies like JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Flask, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. I’m especially interested in backend development because it helps me understand and implement the business requirements behind any product 🚀.

When I’m not coding, I enjoy calisthenics 💪, cooking 🍳, and exploring hydroponics 🌱. Feel free to connect! 🤝

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
positions.description: As a Full Stack Developer intern at Cisco Meraki, I contributed to both the frontend and backend of the product using React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, and RSpec. I developed and optimized backend API endpoints, incorporating cursor-based pagination for improved data handling. Additionally, I built a robust monitoring and observability system using the ELK stack, which included real-time error tracking and visualizations in Kibana and Grafana. My work also involved streamlining processes for release engineers by creating and refining methods to enhance overall product functionality and efficiency. Through these efforts, I resolved critical codebase issues, improving backend logic and developer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · Ruby on Rails · React.js · TypeScript · RSpec · Kibana · Grafana · JavaScript · Front-End Development · Back-End Web Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: NYC Tech Talent Pipeline Fellow
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Embarked on an enriching software engineering fellowship journey, culminating in a 14-week boot camp experience. Engaged in a dynamic curriculum, taking part in around 12 projects. Demonstrated adaptability by actively contributing to both backend and frontend development tasks, fostering proficiency in the PERN Stack. Leveraged rigorous algorithms training to hone problem-solving skills, amplifying performance across boot camp projects and equipping myself for the software engineering world. Collaborated seamlessly with fellow developers, undertaking a wide array of projects that ranged from solo applications to full-stack applications. My role encompassed both frontend and backend development, allowing me to provide comprehensive and well-rounded solutions

positions.description: Exploring the field of Cybersecurity with CodePath Introduction to Cybersecurity pathway. positions.description:
• Collaborated with Bloomberg engineers in a small group setting to build an application using RabbitMQ and Docker.

volunteerExperiences.description: Contributing to Lit Path's mission to improve the affordability of recovery therapy, I will be leveraging my expertise in web development. Collaborating with my team, we will enhance the website by implementing new features and refining both frontend and backend structures, aiming to optimize the overall user experience and functionality. Excited to be part of this impactful initiative.

I serve as a mentor for two students interested in STEM, guiding them as they explore various fields within STEM and sharing my passion for the subject. I provide insights from my own STEM journey, helping them navigate opportunities, develop their skills, and foster a deeper understanding of their interests. This mentorship allows me to both inspire the next generation of STEM professionals and learn from their unique perspectives.

projects.title: TechedIn
projects.description: TechedIn is a social media platform that uses AI analysis to match student technologists to one another so that they can share project ideas and build their dream team. Students can input their interests, post their own projects in search of teammates, explore other people’s projects through the AI-recommended homepage, and instantly connect with students who resonate with their ideas. The platform acts as a bridge for collaboration, enabling students to take their concepts from mere ideas to actual production and deployment.

projects.title: Finance Mate
projects.description:
Revolutionizing Financial Responsibility: Led the development of a cutting-edge finance application designed to empower users with robust financial management tools. Our innovative solution seamlessly integrates four key features:

Interactive Expense Tracker: Delivers real-time insights into spending habits, enabling users to make informed financial decisions.
Smart Budget Tracking: Utilizes intelligent algorithms to optimize budgeting, ensuring users meet their financial goals effectively.
Bank Account Integration: Provides secure access to transactions from any bank, offering a comprehensive overview of expenditures and financial patterns.
CommitteSan: Pioneering digital savings and crowdfunding, this feature fosters collaborative financial planning. Users engage in shared financial goals, contributing weekly to achieve mutual objectives. This groundbreaking concept, inspired by traditional community practices, has been seamlessly digitized for global accessibility.
As the driving force behind this initiative, I spearheaded the development of these features, transforming everyday financial management into a streamlined and engaging experience. Our application not only facilitates financial responsibility but also promotes community-driven savings, marking a significant leap in the evolution of digital finance tools.
